findings.title: isSetupRoute leaves out /connect, the second pairing page
findings.body: The root layout describes pairing as two pages, the scanner (`/pair`) and the manual form (`/connect`) pushed over it (`packages/mobile/app/_layout.tsx:267-270`). `updateResume.ts` treats both as setup screens (`TRANSIENT`, lines 39-40). `isSetupRoute` only matches `onboarding|pair`. A user typing a host and password on `/connect` therefore still gets the full-screen "Update ready" modal when a download finishes. The doc comment says the offer never appears "over onboarding or pairing". Consider adding `connect` to the regex and a test case. `sheetResult.ts:73` shows `/connect` is reached from the pairing flow.
